text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (No matter how far I go, I'm truly just an ordinary Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I've shown Trainer my pathetic, struggling side over and over again, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I ended up showing such a pathetic
side of myself to my fans too.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Dants Frame!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Even so, they're still cheering for me...!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I want to win...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I'll win and win, and shine brighter than anyone—!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's Dants, Dants Flameeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: 1st place, Dantsu Flaaaaaame!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a phenomenal race! The entire venue is in an uproar!
Dantsu Flame, it's Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Raw fighting spirit!
No longer will they call me just a supporting actor—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...
...No, you really are amazing...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However—I see.
There are many things that can only be seen with these eyes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll see how far I can stretch it.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The true star of the show today was Dantsu Flame!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Dantsu Flame stood at the very center of the grand stage—the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"*Sniff*, thank you for the best race ever...!"
"...I'll try my hardest too!"
"I'll work hard just like you and make my dreams come true!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for taking center stage, Dantsu!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Saying thank you for that—
that should be my line...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you...! For—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Thank you for watching me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Amidst roaring cheers and endless applause,
the Japan Cup drew to a close—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san.
I have a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Would you like to relax for a while?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no!
It's not about retiring or anything like that!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'll give it everything I've got at the Japan Cup! To be honest, I was kind of thinking it wouldn't even matter if I had to retire right after.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, after running today and seeing that view...
it made me want to keep running more and more.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "So, after a while, I'd like to mainly focus on my medical treatment and recovery."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to barely scrape by like right now;
I want to get to the point where I'm completely recovered and ready to go.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I realized there is still so much more
I can carve out with these legs of mine."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Back when we first met,
Dantsu Flame used to give a self-deprecating laugh,
saying she wasn't cut out to be the leading star.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she's finally able to puff out her chest and say that――
choice_data_list: Alright, got it. Let's keep running, forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The opening bell rings for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Again and again, over and over.
